title: 10.2.0 | Mid-Chapter
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/0a1331bf85de2e45313ddef9926577d81e1dd8b2.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Survivor Intent System[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Survivors can send and receive text messages during a match[/p][list][*][p]By pressing and holding the scroll-button when using a Mouse, or the right d-pad input on controllers, players can open the messages wheel[/p][list][*][p]8 messages are available for players to select and send[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering the message, and releasing scroll-button/right, will send the message[/p][/*][*][p]Inputs are customizable[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sent messages are shown to all Survivors, next to their information on the left side of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Messages are predefined[/p][list][*][p]Players can customize on Settings their messages selection[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]On Match Details, Players can mute and unmute any other player during a match[/p][list][*][p]Muting is not communicated to the muted player[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]On Settings, players can deactivate the system, if they want to opt out[/p][list][*][p]On Match Details, Players that have deactivated the system are marked with a "no" icon to surface that they have opted out[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]For reducing spamming, a 1s cooldown is applied when players send messages too quickly[/p][list][*][p]If a player keeps spamming, their cooldown will increase up to 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Waiting before sending new messages will reset the cooldown to its shortest duration[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The "Gameplay" section has been added to Settings[/p][list][*][p]The options for the system are on the Gameplay Tab, under "Messages"[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Abandon, Surrender, End Trial[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Abandon Option[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survivor Condition - When all other Survivors are bots, the remaining human Survivor gains the option to [b]Abandon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survivor is considered [b]Abandoned[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Killer Condition - When all remaining Survivors are bots, and at least 1 is not in the Dying State, the Killer gains the option to [b]Abandon [/b](new condition)[/p][list][*][p]Killer is considered [b]Abandoned[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Survivor outcome depends on what state they were in when the Killer Abandoned[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Surrender Option[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survivor Condition - When all the Survivors are in the Dying State simultaneously, Survivors gain the option to [b]Surrender [/b](previously [b]Abandon[/b])[/p][list][*][p]Survivors are considered [b]Surrendered[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]End Trial Option[/b][/p][list][*][p]Killer Condition - When all remaining Survivors are bots, and in the Dying State, the Killer gains the option to [b]End Trial[/b] (new condition)[/p][list][*][p]Survivor outcome depends on what state they were in when the Killer Ends Trial[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note:[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]We removed two existing conditions that could promote negative gameplay behaviours or cause players to leave prematurely. The conditions that were removed are:[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]Survivor Condition - If a Survivor repeatedly recovers from being downed[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Killer Condition - If no Generator has been completed or worked on for a prolonged window[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][i]We added and adjusted existing conditions to ensure the feature's intentions are being met. The intention behind every option type is as follows:[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]Abandon: Gives a Survivor/Killer the opportunity to leave a Trial if conditions do not promote fair or engaging gameplay (i.e. too many bots). This counts as an MMR draw.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Surrender: Gives a Survivor the opportunity to leave a Trial if the outcome is inevitable and unfavourable. This counts as an MMR loss.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]End Trial: Gives a Killer the opportunity to prematurely end a Trial if the outcome is inevitable and favourable. All remaining bot Survivors are Sacrificed, and the MMR outcome depends on the total match results.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][p][i]Dev Note: With this release, we are doing a pass on general perks - the perks new players gain access to when they begin their journey. We want to update them because a lot of them haven't been updated in a long time. Dead by Daylight has changed a lot over the years, so it felt right to adjust these and give them more utility or strength. Between making perk tiers closer in terms of strength, simplification or other improvements, there's something for everyone. Additionally, having released the Diminishing Returns system a few updates ago, we've looked at perks we felt could use some adjustments to account for this system being in the game.[/i][/p][h3][b]Killer Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Agitation[/b][/p][list][*][p]While carrying a Survivor:[/p][list][*][p]You gain [b]14/16[/b]/18% Haste. [i](was 6/12/18%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Your Terror Radius is 12m larger.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bitter Murmur[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within [b]20[/b]m of it for [b]10[/b]s. [i](was 16m and 5s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for [b]16/18/20[/b]s. [i](was 5/7/10s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dark Arrogance[/b][/p][list][*][p]You basic-vault Windows 15/20/25% faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Your missed basic-attack cooldown is [b]15/20/25%[/b] shorter. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is [b]25[/b]%[b] [/b]longer. [i](was 15%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dead Man's Switch[/b][/p][list][*][p]When you hook a Survivor, the first time a Survivor stops repairing a Generator for more than[b] 2[/b]s, it is blocked for [b]30/35/40[/b]s. Cooldown: [b]30/35/40[/b]s. [i](was when a Survivor instantly stopped repairing a Generator, and 25/30/35s block duration and 50s cooldown)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Adding a brief delay before the block can occur will encourage the Killer to pressure the generator they want to defend, which we suspect will lead to more interactivity between both sides.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Deerstalker[/b][/p][list][*][p]Every 40/35/30s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for [b]4[/b]s. [i](was 3s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dissolution[/b][/p][list][*][p]3s after a Survivor takes damage from a basic-attack, for [b]13/14/15[/b]s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed. [i](was any damage and 12/16/20s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Some Killers benefited from this perk a lot more than others. To lower that gap, we're bringing back the basic-attack trigger condition.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Distressing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survivors within your Terror Radius repair[b] 6/7/8[/b]% slower. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Your Terror Radius is [b]30[/b]% larger. [i](was 20/23/30%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dominance[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first time each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor: [i](was Totems and Chests)[/i][/p][list][*][p]It is blocked for[b] 25[/b]s. [i](was 8/12/16s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]That Survivor screams. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You see their Aura for [b]3/4/5[/b]s. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fire Up[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]For each Token:[/p][list][*][p]You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls [b]6/7/8[/b]% faster. [i](was 4/5/6%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You damage Generators [b]6/7/8[/b]% faster. [i](was 4/5/6%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You pick-up and drop Survivors [b]6/7/8[/b]% faster. [i](was 4/5/6%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You basic-vault Windows [b]6/7/8[/b]% faster. [i](was 4/5/6%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Game Afoot[/b][/p][list][*][p]While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damage a Generator, you gain [b]10[/b]% Haste for 8/9/10s. [i](was 7%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Help Wanted[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.[/p][/*][*][p]When that Generator is completed by Survivors:[/p][list][*][p]Your successful basic-attack cooldowns are 25% shorter for [b]70/80/90[/b]s[b] [/b][i](was 40/50/60s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Generators not being repaired regress at[b] 150[/b]%[b] [/b]speed for[b] 70/80/90[/b]s[b] [/b][i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Other Generators lose compromised. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Up to [b]3[/b] Generators can be compromised at a time.[b] [/b][i](was 1 Generator)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hex: Blood Favor[/b][/p][list][*][p]When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured by your basic-attack, Upright Pallets within [b]32[/b]m of them are blocked for [b]13/14[/b]/15s. [i](was any damage and 24/28/32m and 15s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Some Killers benefited from this perk a lot more than others. To lower that gap, we're bringing back the basic-attack trigger condition.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hex: Nothing but Misery[/b][/p][list][*][p]After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack [b]4[/b] times, a Dull Totem ignites. [i](was 8 times)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack:[/p][list][*][p]They gain 5% Hindered for 10/12.5/15s.[/p][/*][*][p]They vault [b]10[/b]% slower for [b]10/12.5/15[/b]s [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hex: Thrill of the Hunt [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.[/p][/*][*][p]When you hook a Survivor, block all Hex Totems for [b]4/5/6[/b]s for each lit Hex Totem.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Thrill of the Hunt has been excelling at totem defense, especially on certain Killers. This update aims at requiring a little more input from the Killer to benefit from the totem defense powerhouse.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Insidious[/b][/p][list][*][p]After being idle for [b]2[/b]s, you gain Undetectable. [i](was 3/2/1s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you act, this ends after [b]6/7/8[/b]s.  [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Iron Grasp[/b][/p][list][*][p]While carrying a Survivor:[/p][list][*][p]Their wiggle is 75% weaker.[/p][/*][*][p]They wiggle [b]10/11[/b]/12% slower. [i](was 4/8/12%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Knock Out[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next[b] [/b]6s, if they move [b]10[/b]m away from it, they gain [b]20[/b]% Hindered for[b] 2/3/4s[/b]. [i](was 6m and 5%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]This ends early if the Pallet is broken. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Machine Learning[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.[/p][/*][*][p]When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:[/p][list][*][p]You gain 8% Haste for 40/50/60s[/p][/*][*][p]You gain Undetectable for 40/50/60s[/p][/*][*][p]Other Generators lose compromised. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Up to [b]3[/b] Generators can be compromised at a time.[b] [/b][i](was 1 Generator)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ravenous[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn[b] [/b]1 Token. For each token:[/p][list][*][p]Gain [b]4[/b]% Haste while carrying Survivors. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hook Survivors [b]4[/b]% faster. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors:[/p][list][*][p]Scream.[/p][/*][*][p]Gain Exposed for [b]80/85/90[/b]s. [i](was 40/50/60s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine[/b][/p][list][*][p]When the trial starts:[/p][list][*][p]4 random hooks become Scourge Hooks.[/p][/*][*][p]The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, Generators not being repaired regress at [b]150/175/200[/b]% speed. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shattered Hope [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem, it is destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever a Totem is blessed, cleansed or destroyed: [i](NEW)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Dull Totems are blocked for [b]16/18/20[/b]s. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hex Totems are blocked for [b]16/18/20[/b]s. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You see the Auras of Boon Totems for [b]16/18/20[/b]s. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Spies from the Shadows[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Survivor scares a Crow within [b]36/38/40[/b]m[b] [/b]of you, you are alerted. Cooldown [b]3[/b]s. [i](was 20/28/36m and 5s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Superior Anatomy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Survivor medium or fast-vaults within 12m of you, the next time you basic-vault a Window, you basic-vault Windows 30/35/40% faster for[b] 10[/b]s[b]. [/b]Cooldown:[b] 20[/b]s. [i](was basic-vault once faster and 25s cooldown)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Unbound[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next [b]26/28/30[/b]s, whenever you basic-vault a window, you gain [b]5[/b]% Haste for[b] 25[/b]s. [i](was 24/27/30s and 7% Haste for 10s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Undone [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn [b]1[/b] tokens, up to [b]3[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all tokens. For each token spent:[/p][list][*][p]The Generator loses[b] 8/9/10[/b]% progress.[/p][/*][*][p]The Generator is blocked for [b]8/9/10[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Unrelenting[/b][/p][list][*][p]Your missed basic-attack cooldown is [b]30/35/40[/b]% shorter. [i](was 20/25/30%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Your successful basic-attack cooldown is [b]10[/b]% shorter. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Diminishing Returns allows us to return the long-since-removed successful basic-attack cooldown. Additionally for cases where you're smacking a lock off a locker or hitting a pallet instead of a player. This perk now also includes obstructed basic-attacks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Whispers[/b][/p][list][*][p]While within [b]28/26/24[/b]m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers. [i](was 48/40/32m)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]While outside of [b]28/26/24[/b]m of a Survivor, you gain [b]5[/b]% Haste. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Survivor Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Better Than New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage:[/p][list][*][p]They bless and cleanse [b]40/45/50[/b]% faster. [i](was 12/14/16%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]They heal [b]40/45/50[/b]% faster. [i](was 12/14/16%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]They unlock Chests [b]40/45/50[/b]%[b] [/b] faster. [i](was 12/14/16%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Blood Pact[/b][/p][list][*][p]While you are not the Obsession:[/p][list][*][p]While you or the Obsession is injured, you see each other's Auras.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you finish healing the Obsession or they finish healing you, while within 16m of each other, you both gain 5/6/7% Haste.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While you are the Obsession if you are hooked another Survivor becomes the Obsession. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Boon: Illumination[/b][/p][list][*][p]While next to a Totem, use Active Ability Button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors within the Boon's range:[/p][list][*][p]See the Auras of Chests.[/p][/*][*][p]See the Auras of Generators.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While you have a Boon Totem, you bless [b]150/175/200[/b]% faster. [i](was bless and cleanse 6/8/10%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bound by Obsession \[Object of Obsession][/b][/p][list][*][p]While you are the Obsession, every 30s, the Killer sees your Aura for [b]4[/b]s. [i](was 3s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]While the Killer sees your Aura:[/p][list][*][p]You see their Aura.[/p][/*][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems [b]8/9/10[/b]% faster. [i](was only cleanse and 2/4/6%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You heal [b]8/9/10[/b]% faster. [i](was 2/4/6%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You repair [b]8/9/10[/b]% faster. [i](was 2/4/6%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Calm Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]You do not scare Crows or scream.[/p][/*][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently and[b] 8/9/10[/b]% faster. [i](was 40/35/30% slower)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dark Sense[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within[b] 20m[/b] of you, for [b]13/14[/b]/[b]15[/b]s: [i](was 24m and 5/7/10s)[/i][/p][list][*][p]You see the Aura of Pallets and Windows within [b]32[/b]m[b] [/b][i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You see the Auras of other Survivors. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You see the Killer's Aura.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Being a generic perk, we saw an opportunity to update it to provide auras that help learn map layouts and pallet spawn points.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Do No Harm[/b][/p][list][*][p]While healing another Survivor for each Hook State they have:[/p][list][*][p]You heal [b]30/35/40[/b]% faster. [i](was 30/40/50%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Great basic Skill Check, grant[b] 3[/b]%[b] [/b]more progress. [i](was separate from the Hook State)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Increase the odds of triggering a Skill Check by[b] 5[/b]%. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Down to the Last \[Sole Survivor][/b] [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you are hooked or complete a generator, you earn [b]1 [/b]Token, up to [b]6[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]For each Token, other Survivors open Exit Gates [b]10[/b]% faster.[/p][/*][*][p]When you are the last Survivor, if you have at least [b]3[/b] Tokens:[/p][list][*][p]You can unlock the Hatch.[/p][/*][*][p]For each Token, the Killer cannot see your Aura for [b]6/8/10[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Empathic Connection[/b][/p][list][*][p]You heal other Survivors [b]30/35/40[/b]% faster. [i](was 25/30/35%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Injured Survivors see your Aura.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Five Moves Ahead[/b][/p][list][*][p]While you are in the Killer's Terror radius or chased by the Killer:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets. [i](was Pallets and Windows)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: 40/35/30s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][i]Dev Note: Following the change to Windows of Opportunity below, we want to make Five Moves Ahead specialize in Pallets.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Flow State[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a generator is completed, earn 1 token, up to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]For each token:[/p][list][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems [b]13/14/15[/b]% faster. [i](was 8/9/10%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You heal [b]13/14/15[/b]% faster. [i](was 8/9/10%)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You unhook Survivors [b]13/14/15[/b]% faster. [i](was 8/9/10%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Friendly Competition[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair [b]10[/b]% faster for [b]80/85/90[/b]s[b].[/b] [i](was 5% for 100/110/120s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Kindred[/b][/p][list][*][p]While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within [b]14/15[/b]/16m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura. [i](was 8/12/16m)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors.
